title: Drift Wood #29 · applications
logline: Chloe mails four envelopes. Wood mails the back page.

panels.composition: The post office. CHLOE at the counter with four fat envelopes, addressed in her tiny capitals. WOOD behind her with a single Timberline.

characters.pose: sliding four envelopes across a counter

balloons.text: One. Media rate. It's the back page.

image.prompt: a small post office counter, a teenage girl sliding four fat envelopes across, a boy in an overcoat behind her holding a single folded newspaper

panels.composition: The four envelopes on the scale. Seattle. Chicago. Portland. Eugene. The clerk's hand.

image.prompt: close-up of four thick envelopes stacked on a postal scale, city names visible on the addresses
image.notes: City names may be lettered after: SEATTLE, CHICAGO, PORTLAND, EUGENE.

panels.composition: Chloe turns. Wood is holding the newspaper open to the back page, to show her the strip, as if it were also an application.

balloons.text: I'm sending this to my grandmother in Coos Bay. She's my readership.

image.prompt: a teenage boy holding a newspaper open to the comics page toward a girl at a post office counter, hopeful

panels.composition: Outside the post office. Chloe walking one way with her receipt. Wood the other. The flag on the pole, wet, not moving.

image.prompt: two teenagers leaving a small post office in opposite directions under a wet flag hanging still on its pole, black and white, no words
